title: Vietnam Communist Party History
duration: 30 hours of lectures + 60 hours of self-study

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key historical events related to the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Recognize the role of the Party in building and developing the country.
Develop systematic understanding of historical knowledge about the leadership, struggle, and governance of the Party.
Develop a sense of national pride and responsibility for the future of the country.
Develop research skills including analysis, synthesis, and generalization of issues related to the history of the Party.
Develop independent work skills and teamwork abilities through analyzing specific issues at a certain historical period.
Develop self-study abilities to complete assigned tasks and assignments.
